host_affine: I_ext[t] = affine_weight.mul_add(x[t], affine_bias) on the host; only the Affine node is applied. The NIR LIF parameters (tau, r, v_leak, v_threshold) are recorded but NOT executed: both CPU oracle and GPU use fixed myelin v0.2.0 LIF dynamics.
